frames.title: Scribd: Home to the world’s documents.
frames.text:
Control your privacy preferences
We and our 56 IAB TCF partners store and access information on your device for the following purposes: store and/or access information on a device, advertising and content measurement, audience research, and services development, personalised advertising, and personalised content.
Personal data may be processed to do the following: use precise geolocation data and identify devices based on information actively requested.
Our third party IAB TCF partners may store and access information on your device such as IP address and device characteristics. Our IAB TCF Partners may process this personal data on the basis of legitimate interest, or with your consent. You may change or withdraw your preferences for this website at any time by clicking on the cookie icon or link; however, as a consequence, you may not see relevant ads or personalized content. You may change your settings at any time or accept the default settings. You may close this banner to continue with only essential cookies.

The largest library of presentation decks from experts around the globe. Show what you know and join a community of lifelong learners.
Share the wealth [of knowledge].
Someone out there is searching for your document. Upload for free, reach a global audience [140M+], and embed directly on your website.
Upload documents

Supported file types: pdf, txt, doc, ppt, xls, docx, and more. By uploading you agree to our Scribd Uploader Agreement.

You must own the copyright to any document you share on Scribd. You can read more about this in our Copyright FAQs.

Know on the go.

Download the Scribd app for insights and answers anywhere and everywhere. Available on web, Android, and iOS.
